name: 08012 · Blackwood, NJ
findings: ZIP 08012 (Blackwood) has 99 nonprofit organizations. 39 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 37 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 08012 (Blackwood) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 08012 (Blackwood) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 63% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 38 organizations here; 35% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 08012 (Blackwood) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 75% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 24 organizations here; 35% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Social and fraternal organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 8 social and fraternal organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 8 organizations here; 35% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do social and fraternal organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 08012 (Blackwood) list civic or political action in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).
